# draw.io viewer

Official `jgraph/drawio` release `v32.3.0`, Apache-2.0.

Source: https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.3.0/src/main/webapp/js/viewer-static.min.js

The unchanged viewer bundle is served locally and runs in an isolated frame. It renders the existing downloadable draw.io XML. The host supplies page selection, zoom and the site's font family. Diagram text, connections and downloadable source are unchanged.
